name: remindly
description: One Remindly app for web, Windows, Android and iOS

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web-app
scripts.build:windows: node web-app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build web-app --config web-app/vite.config.ts && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.mobile:sync: node web-app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build web-app --config web-app/vite.config.ts && cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
